# Authored Bambu-shape fixtures

These are original **synthetic** documents, not exported user profiles or verbatim
vendor files. No real credentials, workstation paths or scripts are included.
The fake values under nonallowlisted keys test projection/privacy boundaries.

The three-document shape, dimensions and exclusion rectangles were checked against
the public P1S/common/root chain pinned in
[the source inventory](../../../../docs/evidence/gate-13/MAKE_PLATE_FIXTURES.md).
The fixture names intentionally differ from vendor names. Two rectangles in the
common profile test grouping; the child overrides that entire exclusion field.
Repeated tool ID `1` represents one tool, not two different nozzles.

These fixtures do not establish support for the owner's reported Bambu `v2.8.0.6`,
all Bambu versions, actual user-profile directories, or installed-slicer behavior.
Tests generate centered/concave beds, invalid input and user-kind documents separately.
